task: Task 13 - Embedding publish boundary and regression protection
assertions: Embedding rejects jobs whose QA Split stage is not EMBEDDING with EMBEDDING_QA_NOT_PUBLISHED and retryable=false.
A pending QA Split Run/Batch does not create an Embedding TaskRun, advance the ImportJob, or change the Document to READY.
Embedding reads only ACTIVE or EMBEDDING_FAILED QaPair rows; pending checkpoint result_payload is ignored.
An incomplete QA Split checkpoint keeps the document in QA_SPLITTING and the import job in QA_SPLITTING.
The QA worker does not enqueue Embedding while the QA stage is still pending.
Existing Embedding success, timeout, retry, count validation, dimension validation, and final transaction tests remain green.

pythonCompile.command: python -m compileall -q server/app/services/embedding_service.py server/tests/test_embedding_task.py server/tests/test_qa_split_run.py server/tests/test_task_reliability.py
